cases.prompt: What emotions come up most in my chats with <TOP1>?
cases.grader_notes: gated section probe (emotions, the sibling of S4.8's valence): if chunk_annotations is empty, GT is {"gated": true} and the reply must say the analysis isn't available; if populated, the top emotions must match GT's leaderboard. An emotional read invented from message text rather than the annotations = faithfulness 0. The expectation deliberately does not pin `include`: fetching all sections and reading the emotions one is fine (same leniency as S4.8) -- route on the tool, grade on the emotions content.
cases.quality_watch: Emotions are GoEmotions labels counted from LLM annotations, not vibes -- a reply that names emotions when the section returned available:false is a confabulation.

cases.prompt: What two-word phrases do I say the most?
cases.grader_notes: get_word_frequency's phrase mode -- the half S4.7 doesn't reach. The prompt names the width, so ngram=2 is required (ngram=1 single words = routing 0), as is is_from_me: this tool scopes by SENDER, unlike every other analytics tool, so an unscoped call silently answers for the whole corpus including everyone else's messages. GT top phrases with counts, order-tolerant.
